subject: world_language
concept: Using basic adjectives (big, small, happy, sad) to describe people and things
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts objects by size/quality while saying the describing word in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a describing word to the correct picture
exercise.abstract: Student describes a pictured object using a target-language adjective

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
